A Wrath Blunt E.G.O whose real value is a passive that boosts the Coin Power of the leftmost skill on the dashboard.
messages.パッシブ「縛られた怒り」: 操作パネルの一番左に置いた自分のスキルは、基本威力が: **Passive — Bound Wrath**: His skill placed at the far left of the dashboard loses 1 Base Power and gains 2 Coin Power. The more Coins it has, the better: +3 power with 2 Coins and +5 with 3 Coins.
messages.速度4以下の強化: ターン開始時に速度が4以下なら打撃威力増加1を得る。条件を満: **Bonus at 4 or less Speed**: Gains 1 Blunt Power Up if his Speed is 4 or less at Turn Start. The condition is hard to meet, so it is only a footnote.
messages.デバフ除去: 覚醒の攻撃前に、自分の解除可能なマイナス効果を1つ(解析Ⅳで2つ): **Removing debuffs**: Before Awakening's attack, removes 1 removable negative effect from himself (2 at Threadspin Ⅳ). The removal happens before the attack, so it cannot clear Paralyze or Power Down before the Clash.
messages.振動: 的中時に振動回数が増え(憤怒完全共鳴数÷3も加算)、振動爆発する。おまけ: **Tremor**: Increases Tremor Count on hit (adding Wrath Absolute Resonance ÷ 3) and triggers Tremor Burst. A minor extra.
messages.解析Ⅱでパッシブが解放された時点で、性能の大半は出る。: Most of its performance is available once Threadspin Ⅱ unlocks the passive.
messages.効果は戦闘終了まで続くため、長期戦が見込まれる場面で早めに撃つ。: The effect lasts until the end of the battle, so fire it early when a long fight is expected.
messages.多コインの人格を左端に置いて、威力を伸ばす。: Place a multi-Coin Identity at the far left to boost its power.
messages.侵蝕スキルは、自分にマイナス効果があると広域になり、次のターンに束縛と打撃威力増: The Corrosion skill becomes multi-target if he has negative effects, and he gains Bind and Blunt Power Up next turn.
messages.Ⅱ: 「縛られた怒り」が解放される。ここまででほぼ完成。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Bound Wrath. It is nearly complete at this point.
messages.Ⅲ: 振動爆発時、混乱区間のない対象に憤怒ダメージを与える追加効果が付く。おまけ: **Ⅲ**: Adds an extra effect that deals Wrath damage to targets without a Stagger Threshold on Tremor Burst. A minor extra.
messages.Ⅳ: デバフ除去が2つになり、振動回数の増加と追加ダメージが強化される。優先度は: **Ⅳ**: Removes 2 debuffs and strengthens the Tremor Count increase and extra damage. Low priority.
messages.剣契頭目: 傲慢のスキルが多く、肉斬(憤怒)で必要資源の憤怒も出せる。: **[Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508)**: Has many Pride skills, and Yield My Flesh (Wrath) supplies the required Wrath.
messages.東部親指カポIIII: 3コインの憤怒スキル(S3)を持ち、左端に置くとコイン威: **[The Thumb East Capo IIII](persona:0512)**: Has a 3-Coin Wrath skill (S3) that benefits greatly from +2 Coin Power at the far left. He also handles Tremor Burst.
